items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I've seen pictures of him and heard about him

ctx.x: I've seen pictures of him and heard about him, Kimberl and many other men. Well, youngster, and they coming over there, you know what I mean? Then by Cap, when he came over here, well, they just jumped over him. He was just crazy with that climate because Cap didn't want to go back over there cutting no more wood with my daddy. So he just playing with some of his own, see? And it was great. It was great. And I still love the musical world. Because I don't think he can find anything any better. But the old man…
That's also a lot of fun.
